w1.code:
w, _ := pool.Begin(ctx)                      // the writer
w.Exec(ctx, `UPDATE accounts SET balance = 70 WHERE id = 1`)
q := `SELECT balance FROM accounts WHERE id = 1`
pool.QueryRow(ctx, q).Scan(&before)          // 100, no wait

w.Commit(ctx)
pool.QueryRow(ctx, q).Scan(&after)           // 70
